headline: Are CL’s Volatile Q2 Options Pricing Telling a Deeper Story About Colgate’s Earnings Quality?
summary: In the past few days, Colgate-Palmolive has drawn attention as expectations for its Q2 results centered on steady international momentum and organic sales growth roughly matching analyst consensus. Options traders have also focused on Colgate-Palmolive, with elevated implied volatility on certain call contracts hinting at expectations for a significant share price move. headline: Will IEA/OECD countries release more strategic oil stocks?
summary: Investing.com -- Europe could contribute heavily to another coordinated strategic oil stock release by September if flows through the Strait of Hormuz or regional energy infrastructure remain materially disrupted, Citi analysts said.

headline: BofA warns oil volatility could force c. banks to abandon look-through’ policy
summary: Investing.com - Persistent oil price volatility caused by global shipping disruptions and geopolitical friction is threatening to entrench core inflation, creating a tough dilemma for major central banks, according to a report by Bank of America (BofA) Global Research. The Wall Street bank warned that standard monetary policy, which typically "looks through" short-term supply-side commodity shocks, may be inadequate after five years of above-target inflation.
